name: ai-insights
description: Track token usage, costs, and AI metrics across GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex.

commands.title: Enable GitHub Copilot Real Cache Data

aiInsights.display.compactNumbers.description: Show token counts in compact format using K/M suffixes (e.g. 1.5K, 1.2M).

aiInsights.providers.copilot.enabled.description: Enable GitHub Copilot session log tracking.

aiInsights.providers.copilot.inputTokenM.description: Multiplier applied to estimated input tokens for Copilot sessions that don't have real token counts (JSON session files). The VS Code native credit tracker counts the full context — system prompt, agent instructions, workspace info, tool results — which Copilot's JSON logs don't expose. Agent-mode sessions typically have 5–15× more input tokens than the raw user message alone. JSONL sessions are unaffected when they contain real promptTokens.

aiInsights.providers.copilot.cacheEstima.description: Estimate GitHub Copilot cache-read and cache-write tokens via turn-over-turn context diffing, used only for interactions without real telemetry. Real cache/input/output tokens are read automatically from GitHub Copilot's own debug-log telemetry when github.copilot.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLogging.enabled is on (see aiInsights.providers.copilot.promptToEnableRealCacheData) - this estimate is the fallback for everything else. Estimated values are always shown as calculated, never presented as measured data. The cache-write split is lower-confidence than cache-read (it assumes all new context gets cached, which isn't always true). Disable to leave un-telemetered Copilot cache tokens at 0.

aiInsights.providers.copilot.promptToEna.description: Show a one-time prompt offering to turn on GitHub Copilot's own github.copilot.chat.agentDebugLog.fileLogging setting, which lets AI Insights read real cache/input/output token counts instead of calculating estimates. Enabling that Copilot setting makes Copilot write your full prompts and code context to local per-session debug-log files (debug-logs/{sessionId}/main.jsonl) that don't otherwise exist - review your own data-handling requirements before accepting. Set to false to never be asked; you can still enable it later via 'AI Insights: Enable GitHub Copilot Real Cache Data' in the Command Palette.

enumDescriptions: inputTokens stays as the real reported total; the cache estimates are treated as subsets of it. Keeps cost calculations accurate. Recommended.

inputTokens is reduced to whatever's left after the cache read/write estimates (often ~0); the cache estimates are additive on top. Matches Claude Code's convention and makes the Cache Efficiency dashboard widget's hit-rate % exact, but can understate cost when the cache estimates exceed fresh tokens.
aiInsights.providers.copilot.cacheEstima.description: How estimated Copilot cache tokens relate to inputTokens. See aiInsights.providers.copilot.cacheEstimation.enabled.

aiInsights.providers.copilot.maxSessionS.description: Maximum number of Copilot sessions kept in the persistent snapshot store (survives Copilot deleting/overwriting its own chat files). Oldest snapshots by end time are evicted once this limit is exceeded.

aiInsights.providers.copilot.additionalS.description: Extra directories to scan for GitHub Copilot session files, in addition to the auto-discovered VS Code workspaceStorage/globalStorage locations. Useful when sessions are stored at a non-default location, e.g. a synced backup or a custom VS Code data dir. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.providers.antigravity.additio.description: Extra Antigravity home directories to scan for sessions, in addition to ~/.gemini/antigravity/. Each path should be a folder that itself contains brain/ and conversations/ subfolders (mirroring ~/.gemini/antigravity/), e.g. a second Gemini profile or a synced backup. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.providers.claudeCode.enabled.description: Enable Claude Code session log tracking.

aiInsights.providers.claudeCode.addition.description: Extra directories to scan for Claude Code JSONL session files, in addition to ~/.claude/projects/. Useful when sessions are stored at a non-default location, e.g. on a remote server or when CLAUDE_HOME is overridden. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.providers.codex.additionalSes.description: Extra directories to scan for Codex rollout-*.jsonl session files, in addition to $CODEX_HOME/sessions (or ~/.codex/sessions). Useful when sessions are stored at a non-default location. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.providers.jetbrainsAI.enabled.description: Enable GitHub Copilot for JetBrains session tracking (reads JSONL partition files from ~/.copilot/jb/). On WSL2 also probes /mnt/c/Users/<name>/.copilot/jb/ so sessions from WebStorm/IntelliJ running on Windows are discovered automatically.

aiInsights.providers.jetbrainsAI.additio.description: Extra ~/.copilot/jb-style roots to scan for GitHub Copilot for JetBrains session partitions, in addition to the auto-discovered locations. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.providers.visualStudio.enable.description: Enable Visual Studio Copilot Chat session tracking (reads MessagePack session files from .vs/**/copilot-chat/). Also supports WSL2: scans /mnt/c/Users/ automatically.

aiInsights.providers.visualStudio.additi.description: Extra directories to scan for .vs/**/copilot-chat/ session folders, in addition to the auto-discovered dev roots. Useful for repos stored outside the usual locations. Supports ~ expansion.

aiInsights.shareHost.description: Optional host/IP to use in shared dashboard URLs. Set this to your computer's Wi-Fi/LAN IP when auto-detected links are not reachable from another device, especially from WSL, SSH remotes, or containers.

aiInsights.sharePort.description: Fixed port for the local share server (0 = auto-assign). Set a fixed port (e.g. 57312) so you can configure a permanent Windows firewall rule and netsh port-proxy when running from WSL.

enumDescriptions: Start a temporary HTTP server on this machine and share a LAN URL.
Upload a dashboard snapshot to a configured sharing server and share its dashboard URL.
aiInsights.sharing.mode.description: How the Share button publishes dashboard stats.

aiInsights.sharing.teamServer.endpointUr.description: Base URL of the AI Insights sharing server, for example https://ai-insights.example.com. Used when aiInsights.sharing.mode is teamServer.

aiInsights.sessionLookbackDays.description: Only load session files modified within this many days.

aiInsights.copilotPlanBudget.description: Monthly Copilot credit budget in USD. Pro=$10, Business=$19, Pro+/Enterprise=$39. Used for budget health widget and forecasting.

aiInsights.teamSize.description: Team size for cost multiplication in forecasts and the status bar tooltip.

aiInsights.alertThresholds.budgetWarning.description: Budget utilization % at which an amber warning is shown in the dashboard and status bar.

aiInsights.alertThresholds.budgetCritica.description: Budget utilization % at which a red critical alert is shown.

aiInsights.alertThresholds.runawaySessio.description: Token count per session above which the session is flagged as a runaway session.
USD cost per session above which the session is flagged as a runaway session.

aiInsights.roi.developerHourlyRate.description: Your developer hourly rate in USD. Used to estimate the value generated by AI assistance (hours saved × rate).

aiInsights.roi.outputTokensPerHourSaved.description: Estimated number of AI output tokens equivalent to one hour of manual developer work. Adjust to calibrate the hours-saved estimate.

aiInsights.tokenCounter.defaultFamily.description: Default tokenizer family used for the live token counter in the status bar.

aiInsights.tokenCounter.highlightEnabled.description: Show alternating colored highlights for individual approximate tokens in the selected text.

aiInsights.tokenCounter.highlightColorEv.description: Background color for even-indexed tokens in the highlight view. Use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA) for transparency.

aiInsights.tokenCounter.highlightColorOd.description: Background color for odd-indexed tokens in the highlight view. Use 8-digit hex (#RRGGBBAA) for transparency.

aiInsights.tokenCounter.statusBarTemplat.description: Template for the live token counter status bar item. Placeholders: {count}, {sel} (empty or " sel"), {model}, {family}, {provider}.
